summary.quick_take: Notion and ClickUp both sit in the broader productivity / knowledge management landscape, but they appeal to slightly different buying motions. Notion leans into recurring payouts, while ClickUp leans into mixed payout terms. The better fit depends on whether you want the cleaner affiliate story, the broader positioning angle, or both.
